description: This file contains functions for performing workspace optimization checks in the Mattermost admin console, specifically LDAP integration and (commented out) guest account checks.

methods.name: usesLDAP
methods.description: Performs an LDAP integration check based on configuration and options, returning an ItemModel with status and details.

methods.name: runEaseOfUseChecks
methods.description: Runs a series of workspace optimization checks (currently LDAP) and returns their results as an array.
